name: PocketBase
description: PocketBase is a single-file open-source backend: an embedded SQLite database, realtime subscriptions, file storage, and a user/admin auth system, all served from one binary with a built-in Admin UI. It uses the muchobien community image (the maintainer-maintained Docker packaging). Starts internal-only -- flip the PocketBase deployment public from its Access control tab once it's up, then open /_/ to finish admin setup. Supports up to two extra superusers at install time (leave their fields blank to skip) -- handy for running one shared instance as a community service rather than a separate deployment per person; more can always be added later from /_/'s own Admins settings once logged in.
